BTS Group is awarded the Sustainability Report Award 2018

Mr. Rangsin Kritalug (Left) Executive Director and Chief Operating Officer, BTS Group Holdings Plc, was handed over the Sustainability Report Award 2018 in the ‘Recognition’ category in the Award Presentation Ceremony of the Sustainability Report Award 2018, organised by Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), Thai Listed Companies Association, CSR Club and ThaiPat Institution, on 7th December 2018 at the Sukri Audithorium, the Stock Exchange of Thailand, Rama IX Road. In 2018, there were a total of 100 listed companies participating in this competition, and BTS Group was one of 56 companies nominated by the committee.

BTS Group ranked among world class Dow Jones Sustainability Indices members

BTS Group Holdings Public Company Limited, the preeminent mass-transit services provider in Thailand and a privately-owned conglomerate, has been officially selected by the Dow Jones Sustainability Indices (DJSI) Emerging Markets 2018 as the first-time member in the Transportation category.

The Dow Jones Sustainability Indices, or DJSI, are a family of indices evaluating the sustainability performance of corporations, broadly recognized worldwide. The indices are divided among industries, with assessment criteria focusing on economic, social, and environmental performance spanning more than 600 criteria. Evaluations are performed in parallel with analysis of financial performance. Every year more than 3,400 publicly listed companies with the highest market capitalizations from 60 industries worldwide are invited to take part in the corporate sustainability evaluation. Investment funds worldwide recognize and have adopted the DJSI for consideration when investing in companies and firms. In 2018, 20 listed companies from Thailand have been selected as DJSI members.

FTSE4Good Index Series 2018

BTS Group Holdings PCL has been selected for a constituent company in the FTSE4Good Index Series 2018, as the BTS Group demonstrating strong environmental, social and governance practices measured against globally recognized standards.

Listed Companies with Outstanding Achievement in Business Sustainability (ESG100) assessed by the ESG Rating Unit of the Thaipat Institute

The Company was ranked as one of the top 100 listed companies that have demonstrated outstanding environmental, social and governance (ESG) achievement in the year 2018, out of 683 listed companies. This showcases the Company’s focus on and responsibility for the environment, society and governance to create sustainable development.

300 Best Public Companies of the Year 2018, organised by Money and Banking Magazine

The Company was ranked as one of the 300 Best Public Companies of the Year 2018, organised by Money and Banking Magazine. The selected 300 listed companies were considered by their strong financial performance, market captialisation, profitability and return on investment as well as liquidity opportunities allowing retail investors to invest for more returns.

DRIVE AWARD 2018, organised by MBA Chula Alumni Association

The Company was awarded the DRIVE AWARD 2018 in Management Category for the second consecutive year, organized by MBA Chula Alumni Association. The leading business, organisations and personal groups were selected by considering from their outstanding performance in driving the economy at the macro level effectively to receive the award in 7 categories consisting of strategic, management, marketing, human resources, finance, local philosopher and community enterprises.

2018 Thailand Top Company Award organised by the University of the Thai Chamber of Commerce, Business Plus Magazine, and ARIP Public Company Limited

The Company was awarded the 2018 Thailand Top Company Award, out of a total of 13 companies that received the awards. This shows BTS Group’s potential to operate its businesses with good governance and social responsibility which is a good model for sustainable development of the organisation.
